covers: JSE morning session, rand and commodities to about 11:45 SAST on Monday 16 November 2026
headline: Telkom jumps 17.8% and SPAR 8.3% on a soft JSE; rand at R16.93/$ and gold slips to $3,861
summary: The JSE All Share was at 112,044 and the Top 40 at 104,036 late in the morning, both about 0.3-0.4% below Friday's close, with miners lower and Telkom (+17.8%) and SPAR (+8.3%) the standout gainers (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 16 Nov 2026 11:27-11:42 SAST). The rand was at R16.93/$, about 1% weaker than Friday's R16.76/$, ahead of October CPI on Wednesday 18 November and the SARB decision on Thursday 19 November (LRC Market Dashboard, 13-16 Nov 2026). Gold was at $3,860.90 (-0.7% from Friday), platinum at $1,461.70 (-1.8%) and Brent at $92.20 (-3.8%); Wall Street has not traded since Friday's close (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 13-16 Nov 2026).

items.title: JSE slightly lower by late morning: All Share 112,044, Top 40 104,036
items.summary: Both indices were about 0.3-0.4% below Friday's close (All Share 112,387.90; Top 40 104,486.60). Miners weighed: Anglo American R827.32 (-2.3%), BHP R656.54 (-2.8%), Implats R173.33 (-2.4%), AngloGold Ashanti R1,451.39 (-1.8%), Sasol R239.49 (-1.4%). Naspers R739.63 (+2.0%) and Richemont R3,505.20 (+2.2%) were higher.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 13 and 16 Nov 2026 11:42 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 16 Nov 2026 11:26-11:27 SAST

items.title: Telkom up 17.8% at R73.04
items.summary: Telkom was the biggest mover among large JSE shares this morning. The headline wire carries reports from Moneyweb and ITWeb that MTN is in early talks to buy Telkom; LRC could not open those articles this run, so no deal terms are given here. MTN was at R230.52 (-1.7%).
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance TKG.JO, MTN.JO), 16 Nov 2026 11:27 SAST; LRC Live Wire headlines (Moneyweb, ITWeb Africa), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: SPAR up 8.3% at R50.56
items.summary: The headline wire carries a Moneyweb report that M&G has called a general meeting to change SPAR's board; LRC could not open the article this run to confirm the details.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance SPP.JO), 16 Nov 2026 11:23 SAST; LRC Live Wire headline (Moneyweb), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: Ninety One down about 7.5%
items.summary: Ninety One plc (N91) was at R42.14 (-7.6%) and Ninety One Ltd (NY1) at R39.48 (-7.5%). LRC has not verified the reason.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance N91.JO, NY1.JO), 16 Nov 2026 11:25 SAST

items.title: Big week for SA data: October CPI on 18 November, SARB rate decision on 19 November
items.summary: The repo rate is 7.25% after September's hike; September CPI was 4.5%. The 10-year government bond yield ended last week at 8.73%.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (SARB MPC dates page; SAnews 21 Oct 2026; Trading Economics SA 10Y), 13-14 Nov 2026

items.title: No US trading yet today; S&P 500 last closed at 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq at 25,136.27
items.summary: Friday's closes left both indices about 2.5% and 2.3% higher on the week. The US 10-year yield closed at 5.15%. Nvidia reports results this week.
